metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates effective at-home exercises that can help relieve symptoms of an enlarged prostate.

These exercises work by reducing tension and tightness around the bladder and prostate, while also strengthening the pelvic floor muscles to improve urinary control, flow, and drainage.

Each exercise works differently. For best results, try them all and continue with the ones that provide the most relief.

Watch now to start getting relief from an enlarged prostate and achieve better bladder control.
